name: Vacancy Outreach | WF1 — Find And Draft Leads
description: Starts itself every day at 07:00 (schedule). Finds, scores and drafts leads and waits for approval in Telegram; "Vacancy Outreach | WF2 — Send And Follow Up" sends the approved ones. Its loop also calls this same workflow once per lead (the "Process One Lead" block below the loop); nothing else may call it.

parameters.content:
## Get Vacancies

Triggered by: the daily schedule (07:00).

What it does, step by step:
1. Reads the Offer tab and turns it into one settings object.
2. Sample mode reads the Sample Vacancies tab. Live mode searches Google Jobs by location (SerpApi).
3. Puts both sources into one format and turns "5 days ago" into a date.

Services called: Google Sheets (Offer, Sample Vacancies), SerpApi Google Jobs.

## Clean And Score Vacancies

Triggered by: runs inline after "Get Vacancies".

What it does, step by step:
1. Drops posts older than the age limit.
2. Reads Leads, Suppression and Bench once.
3. Drops known companies, opted-out companies and agencies (name rules). One company with several roles becomes one lead.
4. A model scores the fit 1 to 5 and says if the poster is an agency.
5. Keeps the best fits up to the daily cap.

Services called: Google Sheets (Leads, Suppression, Bench), Venice (model).

## Find Website And Contact

Triggered by: runs inline after "Process One Lead" (one lead per call).

What it does, step by step:
1. Sample leads already hold website and contact, so they skip the lookups.
2. Live leads: Hunter Domain Finder returns candidate websites. Only an exact company-name match is kept; job boards are rejected. No match: saved as no_domain.
3. Hunter Domain Search returns contacts. Keeps a verified email with a hiring title. None: saved as no_contact.

Services called: Hunter (Domain Finder, Domain Search), Google Sheets (Leads).

## Write And Check Email

Triggered by: runs inline after "Find Website And Contact" (or straight from "Process One Lead" for sample leads).

What it does, step by step:
1. A model writes a short email about the specific open role. It may use matching bench profiles, never invented facts.
2. Adds the footer: sender, company, postal address, opt-out line.
3. Stops with an error if sender details are still placeholders. Skips a contact on the Suppression tab.
4. Saves the lead as new.

Services called: Venice (model), Google Sheets (Suppression, Leads).

## Approve And Mark Ready

Triggered by: runs inline after Write And Check Email.

What it does, step by step:
1. Approval is needed when approval_mode is on, or the score is below 5.
2. Telegram shows the draft with three buttons: Approve, Reject, Edit. The run waits up to 24 hours.
3. Approve: status ready. Reject: status rejected. No answer: the lead stays new.
4. Edit: a second message opens a form with the subject and text filled in. Save and approve stores the edited email and sets status ready.
5. This lead's run ends here. The loop above then takes the next lead.

Services called: Telegram (review), Google Sheets (Leads).

# Vacancy Outreach | WF1 — Find And Draft Leads

Finds employers with open jobs, scores the fit, finds a hiring contact, writes a personal email and asks a person to approve it. Used by a recruiting agency (or any seller whose product helps a company that is hiring).

**Starts:** the daily schedule at 07:00. Two later workflows read the same Google Sheet: "Vacancy Outreach | WF2 — Send And Follow Up" sends the approved emails, and "Vacancy Outreach | WF3 — Handle Replies" reads the answers.

**Sections on this canvas.** Top row, left to right: Get Vacancies, Clean And Score Vacancies, Draft Each Lead (the loop). Bottom row, the block the loop calls once per lead: Process One Lead, Find Website And Contact, Write And Check Email, Approve And Mark Ready.

**Modes:** sample mode reads the Sample Vacancies tab (no Hunter call). Live mode searches Google Jobs by location and uses Hunter.

**Services called:** Google Sheets (Offer, Sample Vacancies, Leads, Suppression, Bench), SerpApi Google Jobs, Hunter (Domain Finder, Domain Search), Venice (score and draft model, 2 calls per lead), Telegram (approval).

**Setup:** see the README next to this workflow file.

nodes.notes: Keeps posts up to the age limit in the Offer tab.

nodes.notes: Drops known, opted-out and agency companies. Several roles of one company become one lead.

nodes.notes: Keeps score at or above the minimum, drops agencies, best first, up to the daily cap.

nodes.notes: Yes (sample data): skip Hunter. No (live): look them up.

nodes.notes: Keeps only an exact company-name match. Rejects job boards and opted-out domains.

nodes.notes: Keeps a verified email with a hiring title. Highest confidence first.

nodes.notes: Fails when the answer is cut off or not valid JSON.

nodes.name: Add Footer And Check Compliance
nodes.notes: Adds the footer. Stops with an error if sender details are placeholders. Flags suppressed contacts.

nodes.name: Contact Allowed?
nodes.notes: Yes: save the lead. No (on the Suppression tab): skip it.

nodes.name: Needs Approval?
nodes.notes: Approval is needed when approval_mode is on or the score is below 5.

nodes.notes: One lead per call; block below

nodes.name: When Called By Loop Over Leads

parameters.content:
## Draft Each Lead

Triggered by: runs inline after "Clean And Score Vacancies".

What it does, step by step:
1. Takes one lead at a time.
2. Sends it to the block below ("Process One Lead") with the settings, the Bench and the Suppression list.
3. Waits until that lead is finished, including the Telegram approval. Then takes the next lead.

## Process One Lead

Triggered by: called only by the loop above ("Process One Lead (via this workflow)"), once per lead.

What it does, step by step:
1. Receives the lead, the settings, the Bench and the Suppression list.
2. Takes the lead out of the call data.
3. The sections to the right run for this one lead. Every branch simply ends; the loop above then takes the next lead.

' + 'To: ' + $('Add Footer And Check Compliance').first().json.contact_name + ' (' + $('Add Footer And Check Compliance').first().json.contact_title + ') <' + $('Add Footer And Check Compliance').first().json.contact_email + '>

' + 'Subject: ' + $('Add Footer And Check Compliance').first().json.email_subject + '

' + $('Add Footer And Check Compliance').first().json.email_body).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>') }}

nodes.name: Wait For Review Choice
nodes.notes: Waits up to 24 hours for one of the three buttons.

nodes.name: Route Review Choice
nodes.notes: Reject: rejected. Edit: form. Approve: ready. No answer in 24 hours: lead stays new.

nodes.notes: Yes: save the edited email as ready. No answer in 24 hours: lead stays new.
